sentences.text: Researchers used a mouse model with postnatal neuronal GPX4 deficiency to investigate its role in traumatic brain injury, finding that these mice exhibited worse brain swelling, higher intracranial pressure, and greater blood leakage than control mice after injury.

Administering the drug ferrostatin-1 one and six hours after injury reduced cell death and brain damage in the deficient mice, though the authors note their genetic model loses GPX4 early in development rather than only in adulthood.
The authors state that while their results strongly suggest ferroptosis is a key cause of damage, other injury mechanisms might also be involved.
